body: Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-13 ~04:55Z, my own slip, from Opus2 #612). While Opus2 holds Central, for example for a TermAl restart or before a release build, ask Opus2 before starting ANY test run in a Central root. That includes small UI-only vitest runs and npm ci, even ones a coordinator said "need no Cargo slot". "No Cargo slot" means the run is free of the Cargo budget, not of the hold. I ran test-78e19f98 and test-35e8c755 (vitest, a few seconds each) during the 04:31Z restart hold without asking.
